dialogue.origin: こんばんは。今日は宜しくお願いします。時間になりましたらスタートしますね。
dialogue.content: Good evening. I look forward to our session today. We'll start as soon as it's time.

dialogue.origin: こんばんは。宜しくお願いいたします。
dialogue.content: Good evening. Thank you for having me.

dialogue.origin: こんばんは。相談員です。今日は相談に来てくださってありがとうございます。初めに、性別、年齢、呼んでもらいたい呼び名を教えていただけますか?　ニックネームでも大丈夫ですよ。
dialogue.content: Good evening. I'm your counselor. Thank you for coming for a session today. To start, could you please tell me your gender, age, and what you would like me to call you? A nickname is perfectly fine.

dialogue.origin: 10代　女です名前はなしでお願いします
dialogue.content: I’m a teenage girl. I’d prefer not to use a name.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます。
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: 今日はどのようなご相談ですか?
dialogue.content: What would you like to talk about today?

dialogue.origin: なんか学校の先生が怖くて…
dialogue.content: Well... I'm scared of a teacher at school…

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 今、何年生ですか?
dialogue.content: What grade are you in now?

dialogue.origin: 高校2年です
dialogue.content: I'm in my second year of high school.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます。先生が怖く感じると、学校に行くのがためらわれますね。
dialogue.content: Thank you. When a teacher feels scary, it can make you hesitant to go to school, can't it?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: いつ頃から、そのように感じるようになったのですか?
dialogue.content: Around when did you start feeling that way?

dialogue.origin: いつからだろう…なんか気付いたら気持ち悪いなって思えてきて
dialogue.content: I'm not sure when... but at some point I realized, and it just started to feel creepy.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。気持ち悪い感じもあるんですね。
dialogue.content: I see. So it feels creepy, too.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 辛いね。
dialogue.content: That must be tough.

dialogue.origin: そんな風に感じるのは、特定の先生ですか?
dialogue.content: Is it a specific teacher who makes you feel that way?

dialogue.origin: はい、そうです
dialogue.content: Yes, it is.

dialogue.origin: 話せる範囲で良いので、その先生についてお話してくれますか?
dialogue.content: Only as much as you feel comfortable—could you tell me about that teacher?

dialogue.origin: 先生は、担任の先生?
dialogue.content: Is he your homeroom teacher?

dialogue.origin: 生徒指導の先生なんですけど、やたら呼び出したり、服装チェックとかするし
dialogue.content: He's the student guidance teacher, and he calls me in excessively for dress code checks and things like that.

dialogue.origin: うんうん
dialogue.content: Mm-hm.

dialogue.origin: 他にも同じ様な格好してる友達はスルーするくせに
dialogue.content: And yet he ignores my friends who are dressed the same way.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。それって不公平に思えますよね。
dialogue.content: I see. That does feel unfair, doesn’t it?

dialogue.origin: はい、なんか舐め回すみたいに見たり、髪触ったり、私的な事聞いてきたりするから気持ち悪くて
dialogue.content: Yes, he looks at me in a leering way, touches my hair, and asks personal questions, so it creeps me out.

dialogue.origin: ええっ・・・そんな風にされると気持ち悪く感じますよね。
dialogue.content: Oh... Being treated like that would certainly make you feel creeped out.

dialogue.origin: どんな時に、そんな態度で接してくるの?
dialogue.content: When does he act that way toward you?

dialogue.origin: 朝校門で髪色チェックとかされて、帰りに呼び出されて、これはいいのかなぁ〜？みたいな、ねっとりした感じで言ってくるからなんか嫌な感じ…
dialogue.content: He checks my hair color at the school gate in the morning, then calls me in after school and says things like, "Is this really okay...?" in this slimy, lingering way. It feels really unpleasant...

dialogue.origin: めっちゃ顔近づけてくるし…
dialogue.content: And he gets his face really close to mine, too…

dialogue.origin: 校門で注意されるだけでなく、呼び出されるんですね。
dialogue.content: So you're not just warned at the school gate, you're also called into his office afterward.

dialogue.origin: それは、気持ち悪いよね。引いてしまいますね。
dialogue.content: That is creepy. It's really off-putting.

dialogue.origin: そんな時、誰か友達とかいますか?
dialogue.content: Is anyone else, like your friends, around when that happens?

dialogue.origin: はい、なんか接し方がおかしいんじゃないの？っていつも感じてて
dialogue.content: Yes, I always feel like there's something off about the way he interacts with me.

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 友達は別々です、個別でそれぞれ呼び出しくらうので
dialogue.content: No, I'm not with my friends. He calls us in individually.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。個別で呼び出されて、先生も一人なんですか?
dialogue.content: I see. So you're called in individually, and the teacher is alone with you?

dialogue.origin: 先生と一対一で
dialogue.content: One-on-one with the teacher.

dialogue.origin: そうなんだ・・・。逃げ出したくなるよね。
dialogue.content: I see... That must make you want to run away.

dialogue.origin: 友達に先生の態度どう？って聞いたら、めっちゃ煩く指導されたって聞いたから、なんかあれ？って
dialogue.content: When I asked my friend what the teacher's attitude was like, she said she got really chewed out, so I thought, "Huh?"

dialogue.origin: 態度ちがうくない？っていう感じで
dialogue.content: Like, isn't his attitude different with me?

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。煩わしく・・・ってことは、友達にはねっとりした感じではないのね。
dialogue.content: I see. So if he was just nagging your friend... that means he wasn't acting that slimy way with her.

dialogue.origin: 多分そうだと思いますめっちゃ怒られたとかって言ってたから
dialogue.content: I think so. She said she got really yelled at.

dialogue.origin: そっか、そっか…。
dialogue.content: I see, I see...

dialogue.origin: 態度が違うのも、不審に感じますよね。
dialogue.content: The fact that he acts differently also feels suspicious, doesn't it?

dialogue.origin: 校門でチェックする時は全然キャラ違っててだから余計に気持ち悪くて
dialogue.content: His personality is completely different when he's doing checks at the gate, and that makes it even creepier.

dialogue.origin: どっちが、ホント?って思いますね。
dialogue.content: It makes you wonder which one is the real him.

dialogue.origin: あなたが不快な思いをしていることを誰か知っていますか?
dialogue.content: Does anyone know that you're feeling this uncomfortable?

dialogue.origin: 多分あいつ変態かもって思えてきて
dialogue.content: I'm starting to think that guy might be a pervert.

dialogue.origin: 親にはチラッと話してみたけど、ただの気のせいでしょって片付けられて
dialogue.content: I briefly mentioned it to my parents, but they just brushed it off and said it was my imagination.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか。
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 面談受けた事あって
dialogue.content: My parents had a conference with him once.

dialogue.origin: うんうん、
dialogue.content: Mm-hm,

dialogue.origin: 親呼び出しで
dialogue.content: My parents were called in.

dialogue.origin: その時のイメージがあるからなんだと思う
dialogue.content: I think it's because of the impression he made on them then.

dialogue.origin: ちゃんとした先生っていう
dialogue.content: —that he's a proper teacher.

dialogue.origin: そっか…親御さんはその先生と面談で話したんですね。
dialogue.content: I see… so your parents spoke with that teacher at a conference.

dialogue.origin: タバコが見つかって
dialogue.content: I was caught with cigarettes.

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: で、呼び出された感じですか?
dialogue.content: And that’s why your parents were called in?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 色々あったんですね。
dialogue.content: It sounds like a lot has happened.

dialogue.origin: 呼び出された時、どんな気持ちでしたか?
dialogue.content: How did you feel when you were called in?

dialogue.origin: うーん、特に…どうせ怒られるんだろうなーくらいで
dialogue.content: Um, nothing in particular... just figured I was going to get yelled at anyway.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。怒られた?
dialogue.content: I see. And did you get yelled at?

dialogue.origin: めっちゃ怒られた(笑)
dialogue.content: I got yelled at a lot (laughs).

dialogue.origin: 先生?　親御さん?
dialogue.content: By the teacher? Your parents?

dialogue.origin: 両方です
dialogue.content: Both.

dialogue.origin: どんな風に怒られたの?
dialogue.content: How did they yell at you?

dialogue.origin: 未成年でなんたら、とかって言ってたかな
dialogue.content: Something about being a minor, and so on.

dialogue.origin: 法律的な感じですね。
dialogue.content: So, from a legal standpoint.

dialogue.origin: 大人もエグいことしてんのにって思いながら聞いてた
dialogue.content: I was listening while thinking, "But adults do some pretty messed-up things too."

dialogue.origin: そんな風に感じているんですね。
dialogue.content: So that's how you feel about it.

dialogue.origin: それはあるかも
dialogue.content: That might be it.

dialogue.origin: 先生も変なの多いし
dialogue.content: There are a lot of weird teachers, too.

dialogue.origin: 確かに、自分のこと棚に上げて…って言いたくなるような大人もいるよね。あなたは、大人のエグさってどんなことを思う?
dialogue.content: It's true, there are adults who make you want to say, "You're one to talk..." What kind of messed-up things about adults come to your mind?

dialogue.origin: 陰で悪さしてるじゃんって。
dialogue.content: Like, they do bad things in secret, you know?

dialogue.origin: でも生徒指導の先生はあれは頭おかしい、絶対
dialogue.content: But that student guidance teacher, he's definitely crazy. Absolutely.

dialogue.origin: そんな風に感じていると、話も聞きたくないですよね。
dialogue.content: When you feel that way, you don't even want to listen to what he has to say, right?

dialogue.origin: 陰で悪さ、が少し気になるのだけれど。
dialogue.content: I'm a little curious about the "doing bad things in secret" part you mentioned.

dialogue.origin: あぁ、児童ポルノとか、盗撮とか、犯罪ばっかじゃんって(笑)
dialogue.content: Oh, I mean like child pornography, upskirting... it's all just crimes, isn't it? (laughs)

dialogue.origin: なるほど。
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: そういう大人もいますね。
dialogue.content: There are certainly adults like that.

dialogue.origin: だから気持ち悪いなーって。あの先生
dialogue.content: That's why he creeps me out. That teacher.

dialogue.origin: そうなんだね。ちなみに、あなた自身は被害に遭ったりしたことはあるの?
dialogue.content: I see. By the way, have you personally experienced anything like that?

dialogue.origin: チカンとかはある
dialogue.content: I've been groped on the train before.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか。気持ち悪かったね。
dialogue.content: I see. That must have been awful.

dialogue.origin: その時はどんな風に対処したのかな?
dialogue.content: How did you handle it at the time?

dialogue.origin: 逃げられた(笑)
dialogue.content: He got away (laughs).

dialogue.origin: 逃げたの?
dialogue.content: You mean he ran away?

dialogue.origin: 捕まえようとしたの?
dialogue.content: Did you try to catch him?

dialogue.origin: ドアが開いたらさっさと降りてったやつはいた
dialogue.content: There was one guy who just quickly got off as soon as the doors opened.

dialogue.origin: 痴漢するだけして…腹立たしいね。
dialogue.content: To just grope someone and run... it’s infuriating.

dialogue.origin: 掴んでやろうと思ったけど、時間がなくて逃げられちゃった
dialogue.content: I was going to grab him, but there wasn't enough time and he got away.

dialogue.origin: スカート短いのも悪いんだけど
dialogue.content: I guess my short skirt is also to blame, though.

dialogue.origin: 勇気ある!!
dialogue.content: You're so brave!

dialogue.origin: なるほど、痴漢されやすかったかも、という感じですね。
dialogue.content: I see, so you feel like you might have been an easy target.

dialogue.origin: 今まで、お話をお聴きしていて、
dialogue.content: Listening to you so far,

dialogue.origin: 触られるのは自分も悪いなとは思ってます
dialogue.content: I do think it’s partly my fault that I get touched.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。スカートの丈?
dialogue.content: I see. The length of your skirt?

dialogue.origin: そうです、スカートの長さ
dialogue.content: Yes, the length of my skirt.

dialogue.origin: そっか…。
dialogue.content: I see...

dialogue.origin: さっき、言いかけたのですが
dialogue.content: As I was about to say a moment ago,

dialogue.origin: 今までお話をお聴きしていて、
dialogue.content: listening to everything you've shared so far,

dialogue.origin: あなたのお話、とても良く整理されていて、あなたがとても不快な事が伝わってきました。
dialogue.content: your story is very well organized, and it's very clear how uncomfortable this situation is for you.

dialogue.origin: あなたは勇気もあるし、とても聡明な人だと感じています。
dialogue.content: I feel that you are both courageous and a very intelligent person.

dialogue.origin: どんなことがあっても、痴漢はする方が悪い
dialogue.content: No matter what, the person who does the groping is the one at fault.

dialogue.origin: でも、それについても、自分なりに振り返ることができていますよね。
dialogue.content: And yet, you're able to reflect on it in your own way.

dialogue.origin: とても素敵な方だと思いました。
dialogue.content: I think you’re a wonderful person.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます。でもまだ高校生だから子供って扱われる事も多くて
dialogue.content: Thank you. But since I’m still in high school, I often get treated like a kid.

dialogue.origin: うんうん
dialogue.content: Mm-hm.

dialogue.origin: 生徒指導の先生が変なのも証明する事できないし
dialogue.content: And I can't prove that the student guidance teacher is being weird, either.

dialogue.origin: 私も悪い事ばっかしてるからいけないんだけど
dialogue.content: And I know it's not right that I'm always doing bad things, too.

dialogue.origin: 年齢的に、確かに大人か子どもか、扱いも難しい時期ではあると思います。
dialogue.content: I agree that at your age, it's a difficult time when people aren't sure whether to treat you as an adult or a child.

dialogue.origin: あなたが、自分の事を振り返る事とは別に、
dialogue.content: Separate from your own self-reflection,

dialogue.origin: 高校生の女子だから、一対一の指導というのは、どこで誤解されるか分からない危険性もあるように思うのです。
dialogue.content: because you're a female high school student, I think one-on-one guidance carries a risk of being misunderstood, or even of being dangerous.

dialogue.origin: はい、先生から何かされるんじゃないかって危機感はいつもあって
dialogue.content: Yes, I always have this sense of danger that the teacher might do something to me.

dialogue.origin: 心配になりますよね。
dialogue.content: That must be worrying.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 特に痴漢とかにあった経験があると、トラウマみたいなもの出てくるときもあるかもしれません。
dialogue.content: Especially with your experience of being groped, it might bring up some trauma-like feelings at times.

dialogue.origin: 担任の先生か、保健室の先生に少しお話してみても良いのかな、と思いますが、どうですか?
dialogue.content: I think it might be a good idea to talk a little with your homeroom teacher or the school nurse. What do you think?

dialogue.origin: そうですね、一旦相談してみます。生徒指導の先生っていう事もあって、うやむやにされるかもしれないけど
dialogue.content: You're right. I'll try talking to them. Since he's the student guidance teacher, they might just brush it aside, though.

dialogue.origin: そうですね。どんな風になるかは分からないけれど、声をあげないと、変わることはないかもしれません。
dialogue.content: That's true. We don't know how it will turn out, but things might not change if you don't speak up.

dialogue.origin: あんま聞いてもらえたことないから期待はしてないけど話はしてみようかなって
dialogue.content: People don't really listen to me much, so I don't have high hopes, but I think I'll try talking to them.

dialogue.origin: うんうん。ちょっと勇気が要るかもしれないけれど。やってみてどうだったか、また聴かせてください。あなたの力になりたいと思っています。また、一緒に考えましょう。
dialogue.content: Mm-hm. It might take a little courage. Please let me know how it goes. I want to be a source of support for you. We can think about this together again.

dialogue.origin: はい、ありがとうございました。
dialogue.content: Okay, thank you very much.

dialogue.origin: 今日の相談は終了して大丈夫ですか?
dialogue.content: Is it okay to end our session for today?

dialogue.origin: はい、大丈夫です。
dialogue.content: Yes, that’s fine.

dialogue.origin: あなたの大切なお話を聴かせてくれてありがとう。
dialogue.content: Thank you for sharing your important story with me.

dialogue.origin: 寒くなっているので、体に気をつけてくださいね。では、相談を終了します。
dialogue.content: It’s getting colder, so please take care of yourself. We’ll end the session here.

dialogue.origin: 聴いてもらえて良かったです。話してみようと思います。ありがとうございました。
dialogue.content: I'm glad I was able to talk to someone. I think I will try to talk to them. Thank you very much.

dialogue.origin: 頑張ってね。応援しています。さようなら。
dialogue.content: Hang in there. I’m rooting for you. Goodbye.

dialogue.origin: 今日はありがとうございました。ロールプレイを終了して良いですか?
dialogue.content: Thank you for today. Is it okay to end the role-play?

dialogue.origin: こちらこそ、貴重な時間をありがとうございました。とても良い勉強をさせていただけました。今日は終了で大丈夫です^_^
dialogue.content: Thank you as well for your valuable time. It was a very good learning experience for me. Yes, we can end for today. ^_^

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございました。終了しますね。
dialogue.content: Thank you. I'll end the session now.

topic.sub: 生徒指導の先生との不適切な関係
